purpose: Define an explicit selected-heart input before admitting multi-heart annotations or training a selected-instance model.

cueProvenance.priorExposure: The same assistant previously reviewed these annotation drafts. These are separately photo-drawn cues, not a blinded independent human selection or a held-out prompt benchmark.
cueProvenance.parentReview: Both selected draft RGB crops and all five shortlisted RGB views visually inspected; photo-only rough selections, not fitted overlap quadrilaterals.

limitations: No labels admitted, split assignments changed or training/inference performed for these proposals. The inventory remains 24 visible-body and 22 partial-material annotations.
All five shortlisted photographs belong to source groups already connected to annotations; distinct photo files do not establish independent motif families or holdouts.
The gold tree is source-clipped and its hidden slit continuation is unverified. Museum lobe appliques require separate uncertainty/exclusion.
The existing 24 body-labelled photographs each contain one identifiable heart; the new multi-heart task ambiguity does not explain previous single-heart model failures.
A crop rectangle is a selection cue, not a body mask. Partial neighboring hearts remain in the cross selection.
nextProtocol: Baseline the existing locator and fitter with the frozen rough boxes, retaining original source pixels, observed coverage and independent editable checks. Do not feed draft polygons or material labels to reconstruction.
For learning, explicitly provide the selected ROI or prompt as model input and transform RGB, body/material labels and uncertainty consistently. Preserve original source and motif grouping.
Score intended-instance selection, source-observed material/contacts and legal reconstruction separately. Do not treat fitting a learned or classified mask as original-design ground truth.
